<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PostDeliveryFollowUp" name="Post-delivery follow-up" processRef="Process_PostDeliveryFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Place order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Hand over shipment" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" targetRef="Task_MonitorUntilDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_FeedbackReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Initiate return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received online or by phone">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_MonitorUntilDelivery" name="Monitor shipment until delivery" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successfully delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorUntilDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorUntilDelivery" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PostDeliveryFollowUp" name="Post-delivery follow-up" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Return initiated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FollowUpMerge" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToFurtherAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherAction" name="Take further action">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToFurtherAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FurtherActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FollowUp" name="Further action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FurtherActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToMerge" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToMerge" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToFurtherAction" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge" targetRef="Task_FurtherAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherAction" targetRef="End_FollowUp"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PostDeliveryActions" name="Post-delivery actions" processRef="Process_PostDeliveryActions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerOrder" name="Place order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Hand over shipment" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information to customer" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_FeedbackReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Initiate return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OrderFulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderChannelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandleOnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandlePhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderChannelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SuccessfulDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseTeam" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Customer order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerOrder" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderToChannelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" name="Order channel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderToChannelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelToOnline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelToPhone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleOnlineOrder" name="Handle order placed through online platform">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelToOnline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandlePhoneOrder" name="Handle order placed over the phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelToPhone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order channel merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToSendTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToSendTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToSuccessfulDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successfully delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToSuccessfulDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToChannelSplit" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToOnline" name="Online platform" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_HandleOnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel = 'online'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToPhone" name="Phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_HandlePhoneOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel = 'phone'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge" sourceRef="Task_HandleOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge" sourceRef="Task_HandlePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToSendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToSuccessfulDelivery" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PostDeliveryActions" name="Customer feedback and returns" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToFollowUpMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Customer return initiated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToFollowUpMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FollowUpMerge" name="Feedback or return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToFollowUpMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToFollowUpMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUpMergeToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeFurtherAction" name="Take further action">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUpMergeToAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FurtherActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FurtherActionComplete" name="Further action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FurtherActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToFollowUpMerge" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToFollowUpMerge" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUpMergeToAction" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowUpMerge" targetRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction" targetRef="End_FurtherActionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
